Specific_Friction: Enterprises governing major capital projects with a single Excel spreadsheet tracking all pipeline — where cells contain one word and information lives in people's notebooks — have zero standardized workflow, zero post-project validation, and zero visibility into whether projects actually delivered promised savings. 'We used to just get a project completed and consider it done.' Projects execute without anyone checking if they actually achieved their goals. Version control becomes a nightmare when every project has dozens of hands across multiple departments. No way to answer: Does this project align with our corporate pillars? Do we have the bandwidth? Does it actually get us where we need to go in five years?
Severity/Impact: Critical. Project management transformation at retail logistics. Named execs: Carolyn Lum (Senior Manager of Continuous Improvement), Nicole Fakhri (Manager of Continuous Improvement), Walmart Canada. Quantified: instant project approval; fewer and shorter status update calls; tracking actual savings and CO2 emissions at portfolio level; one master data set for entire division; 2.4M online customers, 400+ stores nationwide. Quote: 'Having that visibility within Wrike of the entire pipeline in one place, with real-time data that is consistently there, is one of the biggest benefits and something we have never had before.'

Specific_Friction: Marketing teams running on text/Excel-based project management tools for years face a visibility crisis: individuals see only their own slice of work, project managers spend all day in 'cat-herding mode' manually notifying and updating status, and stakeholders can't self-serve project information — requiring direct outreach to PMs for every status check. 'You couldn't see the full workflow. You'd only see just your piece of it.' Without visual, interactive project management, large-scale asset creation becomes impossible to coordinate and capacity overload stays hidden until it becomes a crisis.
Severity/Impact: Critical. Marketing operations transformation at supply chain SaaS. Named execs: PT Umphress (Global Director of Digital Marketing Operations), Wayland Fox (Senior Marketing Director), Jessica Bargenquast (Project Manager), Blue Yonder. Quantified: 125 initial licenses expanded to include legal, renewals, and revenue operations; 60 days to decommission 9-year-old tool and build Wrike; dashboards showing 30-day overload and capacity; process standardization across teams and regions; ~8,000 associates, 35+ offices worldwide. Quote: 'When we switched to Wrike, it was like turning on all the lights. Now everybody can see — there is everything we need.'
